title: Final Probabilities
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expressions for the probabilities P(nu_mu) and P(nu_tau) must be provided.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the energy of the neutrinos and the perturbation frequency must be correctly derived.

title: Minimum Perturbation
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum value of hbar omega_1 that can be detected must be correctly calculated.

title: Time of Flight
description: Important Criteria: The time of flight calculation must be accurately applied to find the relationship with M_0.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors or incorrect assumptions in the calculations must be identified and avoided.
